description: Symmetric and asymmetric encryption, key generation, digital signatures, hashing and credential storage, plus access to blockchain data and transactions.

tools.name: Encrypt
tools.description: Encrypts an expression, string or byte array with a symmetric key or a password, returning an EncryptedObject. Cipher, mode and initialization vector are handled automatically or can be specified. Use it to protect data at rest and in transit.
tools.usage:
Encrypt[key, expr]
Encrypt["password", expr]
Encrypt[key, expr, Method -> spec]
tools.notes: A password-based key is derived with a key derivation function; store keys with SystemCredential rather than in notebooks.

tools.name: Decrypt
tools.description: Decrypts an EncryptedObject using the matching symmetric key, password or private key. It returns the original expression or byte array. It fails gracefully with a message if the key does not match.

tools.name: GenerateSymmetricKey
tools.description: Generates a random symmetric encryption key, or derives one from a password. The cipher and key size are configurable. Use it as the starting point for symmetric encryption workflows.

tools.name: GenerateAsymmetricKeyPair
tools.description: Generates a matched public and private key pair for asymmetric cryptography, by default RSA. The pair is returned as a PrivateKey and PublicKey inside an association. Use it for signing, key exchange and public-key encryption.

tools.name: GenerateDigitalSignature
tools.description: Creates a digital signature for data using a private key, proving origin and integrity. The hashing algorithm can be specified. Use it to sign documents, releases and messages.
tools.usage:
GenerateDigitalSignature[expr, privkey]
GenerateDigitalSignature[expr, key, Method -> spec]

tools.name: VerifyDigitalSignature
tools.description: Checks a digital signature against the data and a public key, returning True or False. A False result means either the data or the signature has changed. Use it to validate signed content before trusting it.

tools.name: EncryptFile
tools.description: Encrypts the contents of a file, writing an encrypted file that DecryptFile can restore. It works on files of any size without loading them entirely into memory. Use it for protecting data files and archives.

tools.name: DecryptFile
tools.description: Decrypts a file produced by EncryptFile using the matching key or password. The output file path can be specified explicitly. Use it as the restore half of file-level encryption.

tools.name: Hash
tools.description: Computes a cryptographic or non-cryptographic hash of an expression using a named algorithm such as "SHA256", "MD5" or "CRC32". The result can be an integer, hexadecimal string, base64 string or ByteArray. Use it for integrity checks, deduplication and cache keys.
tools.notes: FileHash hashes file contents; hashing an expression hashes its structure, not its printed form.

tools.name: FileHash
tools.description: Computes a hash of a file's contents without loading the whole file into memory. Algorithm and output format match those of Hash. Use it to verify downloads and detect file changes.

tools.name: SystemCredential
tools.description: Reads and writes credentials in the operating system's secure credential store, so secrets never appear in notebooks or files. Values are set by assignment and retrieved by key. Use it for API keys, passwords and tokens.
tools.notes: SystemCredentialKeys lists stored keys; never commit credential values to version control.

tools.name: GenerateSecuredAuthenticationKey
tools.description: Creates an OAuth-style secured authentication key that allows an external application to act on your behalf against Wolfram Cloud APIs. Keys can be listed and revoked. Use it when integrating deployed APIs into other systems.

tools.name: BlockchainData
tools.description: Returns general information about a blockchain, such as the latest block height, difficulty and network parameters. The blockchain is chosen with the BlockchainBase option. Use it as the entry point for blockchain queries.
tools.notes: Requires an internet connection and Wolfram blockchain service access.

tools.name: BlockchainBlockData
tools.description: Retrieves data about a specific block, identified by height, hash or a relative position such as -1 for the latest. Properties include timestamp, transaction list, miner and size. Use it to inspect blockchain history.

tools.name: BlockchainTransactionData
tools.description: Retrieves details of a specific blockchain transaction by its identifier, including inputs, outputs, fees and confirmations. Properties select individual fields. Use it for payment verification and chain analysis.

tools.name: BlockchainAddressData
tools.description: Returns information about a blockchain address, such as balance, transaction count and associated transactions. It works across the supported chains. Use it for wallet monitoring and auditing.

tools.name: BlockchainTransaction
tools.description: Constructs a symbolic blockchain transaction from inputs, outputs and metadata, which can then be signed and submitted. It represents the transaction before it is broadcast. Use it to build transactions programmatically.
tools.notes: BlockchainTransactionSign and BlockchainTransactionSubmit complete the workflow; submitting a transaction moves real value, so test carefully.

tools.name: BlockchainContractValue
tools.description: Reads a value from a smart contract on a supported blockchain, calling a named contract method with arguments. It returns the decoded result. Use it to query on-chain state from Wolfram Language code.

tools.name: BlockchainTokenData
tools.description: Returns information about tokens on a blockchain, such as balances and metadata for a given address or contract. It covers standard token interfaces. Use it for token portfolio analysis.

tools.name: BlockchainKeyEncode
tools.description: Encodes cryptographic keys into blockchain-specific address and key formats such as WIF or hexadecimal addresses. It bridges generic key objects and chain conventions. Use it when deriving addresses from key pairs.

tools.name: BaseEncode
tools.description: Encodes a ByteArray as a base64 string, or another base-N encoding if specified. It makes binary data safe to embed in text, JSON and URLs. BaseDecode reverses the operation.
